_documentation.purpose: Per-class release-gate thresholds. Resolved most-specific-wins: by_track_x_vehicle > by_vehicle_class > by_track_class > default.
_documentation.fields: See ThresholdProfile dataclass in release_gate.py for the full field list.

default.description: Conservative default — used when no class override applies

banked.description: Banked tracks have higher real transition rates and naturally sparser bucketed coverage on the centerline

flat.description: Flat tracks should have low transition activity

GT4.description: GT4 is the calibrated reference class — strict tire-model expectation

TouringCar.description: TouringCar tire D scale is uncalibrated as of v1 — wider lambda band, looser residual

TCR.description: FWD touring car — drive_rear_only assumption violated, wide tolerances

banked,GT4.description: Daytona-with-GT4 is the calibrated baseline — tightest expectations

flat,TouringCar.description: Spa-with-BMW M2 — known sparse-coverage scenario; relaxed FB ceiling so the gate doesn't FAIL on data-density alone
